regions.name: Ocean (W strip, x0-21)
regions.problem: ruler-straight coast, hard sand/ocean line, only 2 depth bands - reads stamped-on
regions.intent: fractalize the shoreline and lay a proper deep->shallow->beach->flat gradient

regions.name: Central sand flat (x22-55)
regions.problem: large featureless dead zone - no cover, no reason to move through it
regions.intent: add a dry wash/old path across it and a scatter of vegetation + a small hill for cover

regions.name: Rock massif (NE + SE lobes)
regions.problem: solid inert stone - a mountain with no interior and abrupt feet
regions.intent: carve a mysterious cave chamber into the SE core; add talus/hill at a foot

regions.name: Gravel outcrops (scattered)
regions.problem: fine as texture but a bit noisy; one can host a ruined structure
regions.intent: site an old ruin on the mid-west outcrop as a landmark; smooth confetti

edits.rationale: A dead-straight N-S coast is the map's biggest artificiality tell. Push shallow water in/out irregularly so the land/sea boundary meanders like a real shore.
Real coasts ramp through depth then a wet beach then dry flat. Repaint the coastal band x0-30 W->E as ocean deep, ocean shallow, wet sand, dry sand so there is no hard line.

edits.what: Old dry wash / trail across the flat
edits.rationale: A gravel wash from the SW toward the NE massif gives the empty center a line of movement, a subtle chokepoint, and a story (old traffic). Waypoints stay in open sand per the briefing.

edits.what: Sparse hardy vegetation on the flat
edits.rationale: Bare sand with zero flora looks lifeless. Sprinkle mossy/soil patches (desert scrub) lightly, clumped, only over sand, so a few plants cluster in hollows.
A lone low hill at ~(38,52) breaks the dead zone, gives high-ground cover, and reads as a natural erosional remnant near the wash.

edits.what: Mysterious cave chamber in the SE massif
edits.rationale: Region #3 (mountain, centroid ~92,92) is solid RockFace. Carve a chamber into its core - carve_chamber only eats solid rock, so it stays enclosed. A cave gives a fortress/high-risk interior.

edits.what: Talus foot at the NE lobe
edits.rationale: The NE rock lobe (~70,32) meets sand abruptly. A rubble hill at its foot softens the transition and adds light cover on that approach.

edits.what: Ruined structure on the mid-west outcrop
edits.rationale: Outcrop #6 (~28,61) is a natural landmark site. Lay an ancient-concrete footprint as a ruined building pad - a story beat and a defensible strongpoint.
7 tiny patches flagged by the fragmentation metric. Majority-smooth non-water families so lone specks dissolve into their surroundings.

notes: Cave chamber: layer ancient danger or an infestation deep in - the interior is not free real estate.
Ruined structure: a few slain ancients + salvage; ties to the crashed-Factory-ship scavenger theme.
Old wash/path: expect raiders to path along it - anchor a killbox where it meets the base.
Coastal mud beach: brackish, non-potable - reinforces the water-scarcity pillar (must desalinate).
